answer: In an agent market trading saffron and nectar, every seller identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days to receive a daily order quota; quotas cannot be transferred or reused across identities. Even at the zenith of demand, creating 1,000 fake sellers therefore ties up $100,000 rather than granting free capacity. The defense does not prove identities are unique: it makes sybil scale consume capital, with an opportunity cost for every extra account.
